decisions.rationale: Fen chapel, 7.5 x 18 m, tarred-plank nave on a stone sill under reed thatch, a timber belfry with a hanging bell to 15.2 m; 880 triangles, 76,044 bytes before meshopt. Walls stay inside the oriented-box collider below 3 m and eaves overhang at most 0.78 m above it (check-kit: OK); baked AO at 48 samples.
limitations: The bell is a simple lathe shape; it does not swing or ring.
Thatch uses the W0 thatch layer: no ridge binding or eaves cut.
Surfaces are tiled 2 m layers shared by the whole kit; there is no unique wear, grime gradient or decals per building.

decisions.rationale: In Reed Chapel (Fens; the lore's reed-roofed chapel) at gameplay cameras (18-40 m, pitch 0.38-1.13): reads at true scale beside the 2.25 m soldier, the 2.7 m captain and the 3.9 m boss; shadows ground it on the relief; the 1.6-3.2 m architecture cutaway keeps the hero visible behind it, and a camera inside its bounds (plus 2 m) hides it instead of showing the hollow inside.
limitations: Not enterable: interiors are not modelled.
Lighting is the overcast day grade only; windows never light up.
